params.name: emailAddress
params.description: The user's email address, used to identify the SSO configuration by email domain

params.name: redirect
params.description:
When true, returns HTTP 303 and may include a Location header.
When false, returns HTTP 200 with the redirect URL in the response body.

items.docs:
Initiates the SSO authentication process by redirecting the user to their configured Identity Provider (IdP).

What this endpoint does:
1. Looks up the SSO configuration based on the user's email domain
2. Generates a SAML authentication request
3. Returns the SAML request in a 200 or 303 response depending on request parameters

Note: This does not authenticate the user directly. It starts the redirect flow to the IdP.

params.name: code
params.description: Authorization code from Auth0 after successful IdP authentication

params.name: redirect_uri
params.description: Must exactly match the URI used in the initial authentication request

params.name: state
params.description:
State token for session tracking and CSRF protection.
Contains the SSO configuration scope level.

items.docs:
Completes the SSO authentication flow after the user has authenticated with their Identity Provider.

Flow:
1. User authenticates at the IdP
2. IdP sends SAML assertion to Auth0
3. Auth0 exchanges it for an authorization code
4. This endpoint receives the code and exchanges it for user tokens
5. Returns a LoginTokenX object for authenticated API use

params.description: ID of account, refers to account.id
